summary: Former 97-foot tower at Tuppers Plains in Meigs County, OH, registered 2014 and listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the register; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Added to the FFLOS register September 3, 2014; nominated by Mark

evidence.supports: marked as gone, registry number US 1574, OH 20
evidence.quote: Tuppers Plains Meigs 39.15635 -81.82488 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1574, OH 20

evidence.supports: unincorporated community on the boundary of Olive and Orange townships in Meigs County
evidence.quote: unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) on the boundary of Olive and Orange townships in Meigs County, Ohio
As of the 2020 census, Tuppers Plains had a population of 438

corrections.why: The register's title spells Site as Stie; the other Ohio entries in the register use Tower Site

sources.title: Tuppers Plains Tower Stie
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Only the register entry, the Ohio list and an encyclopedia lead were usable. Two searches found no build date, staffing, fire history or present-site description. A Meigs County Historical Society photo post from July 21, 2019 (facebook.com/meigshistory/posts/2943446459213231/) may hold height detail and a dismantling question; the page is login-walled and was not readable, so nothing from it is used or cited. Access and visit values are inferred from the gone status. The register's 97 ft is the overall height, so it is not entered as height_m, which the guide defines as height to the cab floor.
